open_points.subject: A20 rule 3 host support versus A03 rule 8 sandbox start check
open_points.text: “the kernel neither tests the host nor defines what it does on an unsupported one” contradicts “The kernel checks at start, before recovery and before the surface opens, that `bubblewrap` is present and that one probe execution succeeds”
open_points.question: Must the kernel still perform A03’s sandbox probe on Linux, or does A20 prohibit that host/facility test?
options: Keep the A03 probe and clarify that A20 prohibits only explicit OS/version/facility detection
Remove the probe on unsupported Linux hosts
Define the probe’s failure as the behavior for Linux lacking required sandbox facilities
open_points.default_guess: Keep the A03 start probe and interpret A20 as prohibiting explicit compatibility detection, not the required operational sandbox probe.
